source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    To check setting dedicated port as static for ipv6 is normal.
1. Plug network cable on dedicated  and chcek the link status
2. Power on system and boot into BIOS setup
3. Goto "server mgmt" page to check BMC ip
4. Check the ip source is on Static mode
5. Use this to login BMC Web

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Check the ip can be present on BIOS
2. Check the Web can be login

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Set dedicated port as static(IPv6) (Dedicated as static IPv6): agent verifies the assigned static address with ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" -H "$BMC_IP" lan print 1 2>&1 | grep -iE "IP Address|Subnet|Gateway" (or Redfish EthernetInterface read via curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" "https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/1/EthernetInterfaces/1" 2>&1); entering the static IP + web-login are operator/BMC-UI steps.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the lan-print/Redfish IPv6 static address so the user confirms the Dedicated port is static(IPv6) and reachable; the static-entry + web-login are operator/UI.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: changing to a bad static IP can cut management access; enter a valid address and keep a console path.

original_test_intent: Verify that the dedicated BMC port accepts the approved static IPv6 address and routing parameters, displays the address in BIOS Server Management and supports BMC WebUI login over IPv6.
original_method: An engineer connects the dedicated port, enters BIOS, confirms Static mode and the configured IPv6 address, then logs in to the BMC WebUI through that IPv6 endpoint and reviews errors.
manual_activity: Physical cabling, BIOS Static-mode/address inspection and the authenticated IPv6 WebUI login are explicit core criteria requiring an engineer. API readback can only support them.
required_inputs: Static IPv6 address, scope, prefix length, gateway/route, VLAN and DNS policy
Current source/address state, credentials, KVM/console and restoration values
safety_requirements: Do not enter a guessed global or link-local address, prefix or gateway.
Validate the mapped BMC channel and keep an independent console recovery path.
Protect credentials and do not treat TLS bypass as a default formal method.
Stop on duplicate-address detection, route failure, wrong source or management loss; preserve evidence and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Collect mapped-channel IPv6 source/address/prefix/route and BMC health before and after the engineer's action.
Correlate network reservation/DAD evidence with BIOS and WebUI records.
Verify final reachability and organize logs without setting the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact IPv6 tuple, scope and rollback.
Perform cable connection, BIOS Static-mode/address inspection and IPv6 WebUI login.
Issue PASS/FAIL after exact-value and route validation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Supporting only. Generic IP Address/Subnet/Gateway filtering may omit IPv6 origin, prefix and route details; channel and Redfish instance must be discovered, not assumed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the mapped vendor-supported endpoint to retain complete IPv6 source, address, prefix, gateway/route and MAC data with protected credentials.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Static IPv6 source, BIOS display, WebUI login, cable action and 5/0-minute fields remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN HUMAN BIOS/WEBUI METHOD WITH IPV6 VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Archive the prior state, validate the address/prefix/route and DAD policy, test console recovery, have the engineer enter/confirm the values, then correlate BIOS, API, route and authenticated IPv6 WebUI evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Mapped BMC port and approved IPv6 management segment.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, management API/tool and network-plan revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC IPv6 configuration guide and approved IPv6 allocation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds scope, prefix, route, DAD and rollback controls without replacing UI checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; a link-local-only success cannot silently satisfy an approved global-address test.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A syntactically valid address can still be unusable because of prefix, route, VLAN or scope errors.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies the accepted address scope and exact tuple and chooses the approved final state. Missing site values are readiness gaps, not permanent BLOCKED. An API-only method would omit explicit BIOS/WebUI coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved IPv6 allocation, mapped channel/MAC, prior state and rollback
BIOS screenshots showing Static source and exact IPv6 address
DAD/route evidence and authenticated BMC WebUI login over the intended scope
Final configuration/reachability, health logs and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently describes static IPv6 configuration and UI verification; omitted address values and scope are project inputs rather than contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operation is understandable. Site-specific IPv6 parameters and approvals determine readiness but do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retain its lockout warning but reject PARTIAL and incomplete IPv6 readback as formal coverage.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its full IPv6 scope/route/recovery analysis while applying MANUAL ONLY to the explicit UI core.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates exact IPv6 readiness from automated corroboration and human acceptance.

review_improvement: Requires exact scope/prefix/route and DAD evidence, preventing a merely present but unusable IPv6 address from satisfying the test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The static configuration can be read automatically, but BIOS presentation and WebUI login are the stated core outcomes. Under locked V3.1 those human UI checks make this MANUAL ONLY, with agent support for precise IPv6 validation.
